# m.stocks.ipos

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Initial public offerings on US exchanges, upcoming and past, one row per offering.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.stocks.ipos(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.UPSERT`, which adds and updates rows and never deletes them, one row per `Symbol` and `IssuerName`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Stock tickers; None, the default, for every offering. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first listing date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last listing date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | The field to sort by, such as `"listing_date"`. Fields: `listing_date`, `ticker`, `last_updated`, `security_type`, `issuer_name`, `currency_code`, `isin`, `us_code`, `final_issue_price`, `min_shares_offered`, `max_shares_offered`, `lowest_offer_price`, `highest_offer_price`, `total_offer_size`, `shares_outstanding`, `primary_exchange`, `lot_size`, `security_description`, `ipo_status`, `announced_date`. |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The sort direction; here it works without `sort` too. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows: in total for `symbols=None`, per ticker when tickers are named. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"ipo_status": "pending"}`. Keys: `ipo_status`, `isin`, `us_code`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The ticker symbol of the IPO event." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `AnnouncedDate` | String | The date when the IPO event was announced. |
| `CurrencyCode` | String | Underlying currency of the security. |
| `FinalIssuePrice` | double | The price set by the company and its underwriters before the IPO goes live. |
| `HighestOfferPrice` | double | The highest price within the IPO price range that the company might use to price the shares. |
| `IpoStatus` | String | The status of the IPO event. IPO events start out as status "rumor" or "pending". On listing day, the status changes to "new". After the listing day, the status changes to "history". The status "direct_listing_process" corresponds to a type of offering where, instead of going through all the IPO processes, the company decides to list its shares directly on an exchange, without using an investment bank or other intermediaries. This is called a direct listing, direct placement, or direct public offering (DPO). |
| `Isin` | String | International Securities Identification Number. This is a unique twelve-digit code that is assigned to every security issuance in the world. |
| `IssuerName` | String | Name of issuer. |
| `LastUpdated` | String | The date when the IPO event was last modified. |
| `ListingDate` | String | First trading date for the newly listed entity. |
| `LotSize` | double | The minimum number of shares that can be bought or sold in a single transaction. |
| `LowestOfferPrice` | double | The lowest price within the IPO price range that the company is willing to offer its shares to investors. |
| `MaxSharesOffered` | double | The upper limit of the shares that the company is offering to investors. |
| `MinSharesOffered` | double | The lower limit of shares that the company is willing to sell in the IPO. |
| `PrimaryExchange` | String | Market Identifier Code (MIC) of the primary exchange where the security is listed. The Market Identifier Code (MIC) (ISO 10383) is a unique identification code used to identify securities trading exchanges, regulated and non-regulated trading markets. |
| `SecurityDescription` | String | Description of the security. |
| `SecurityType` | String | The classification of the stock. For example, "CS" stands for Common Stock. |
| `SharesOutstanding` | double | The total number of shares that the company has issued and are held by investors. |
| `TotalOfferSize` | double | The total amount raised by the company for IPO. |
| `UsCode` | String | This is a unique nine-character alphanumeric code that identifies a North American financial security for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
